# ADR 0002: Sequence the decisive check first, then run independent checks in parallel

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** KYC identity verification orchestrator

## Context

Provider calls cost money and time; an identity mismatch makes the other checks pointless.

## Decision

Identity lookup first; on a match, face match and watchlist run concurrently on virtual threads; address is async.

## Consequences

Lower cost and latency. Orchestration code must handle partial results.

## Alternatives considered

All checks in parallel; all sequential.
